decisions.reason: The cross-requirement effect is already fully captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, which requires each website product listing to be completed while the product is added to the list.
The instruction changes when product-channel listings are completed, but it does not change which products the catalog spreadsheet tracks or the requirement to record sourced products in the list.
Completing product listings while adding products to the list does not change the sourcing platform or the evidence used to select products.
The source concerns ecommerce product listings, not scheduling or publishing daily social-media posts.
The product-listing workflow does not alter the requested social content-bank artifact or its storage platform.
The source decision is unrelated to the CRM structure deliverable and its designated document.
The instruction about completing ecommerce listings does not change the Pinterest competitor-research deliverable or its required links.
The ecommerce listing instruction does not affect the deferred HubSpot contact-property configuration requirement.
